reviews.text:
Fantastic veterinary clinic, I highly recommend it! The team is welcoming, available, and attentive. Dr. Jeannin is truly excellent—a good listener, reassuring, and he takes the time to explain things clearly. You can trust him completely.
Thank you to the whole team.
Attentive, reassuring, and with good advice, I highly recommend him!

I do not recommend this vet for serious health problems. Very kind, very welcoming, but clearly inexperienced. My poor cat suffered the consequences...

My response to the vet's reply below:
I am appalled by such bad faith... None of the information you provide is true!

Let me remind you of the facts:

- First of all, I never complained about your predecessors. My previous vet of 15 years was replaced, and I wasn't comfortable with his successor.

- I came to see you because my cat couldn't eat anymore, but you didn't find anything. You gave me Pansoral for the mouth ulcers...
- I came back, insisting, convinced there was a real problem with his tongue. That day, you had a colleague who was an ultrasound technician, so we performed the ultrasound you advised me to have done, contrary to what you claim. I left without a diagnosis but with a much lighter wallet... you never mentioned a tumor...
- Maybe a week later, I went to the emergency vet in Bron because I noticed my cat's tongue was necrotic and split in two... They suspected it was a tumor but said further tests would be needed. Given her condition and age, I decided to spare her all that.

- So you diagnosed absolutely nothing, and I carried out all the treatments and checkups you recommended. It was your lack of a diagnosis that wasted Plume's time, not my determination to cure her, as you claim.

I find it very inappropriate, clumsy, even inhumane to make me bear the responsibility for her suffering, when I was insisting on a point you clearly overlooked.

I understand you're defending yourself, but you could have simply admitted your mistake instead of accusing me of mistreatment.

Your attitude is unprofessional, and it's clearly a lack of competence that you lack, if spotting a tumor on a cat's tongue doesn't require experience.

I delayed posting this comment because I didn't want to cause you any harm, but I was finally overcome by my anger. Seeing your despicable response, I have no regrets.

Excellent experience! The vet was attentive, offered good advice, and took the time to examine the animal thoroughly. A wonderful team!

I highly recommend them.

A beautiful clinic where our animals are warmly and gently received. The team is kind and very professional. In the waiting room, there are toys to keep our four-legged friends entertained. A very clean, elegant, and calming clinic. Thank you to the team for offering such an innovative and unique place.

I highly recommend the Agapé clinic and its entire team! 🐾 My dog ​​was seen very quickly after a bite, following a phone consultation. I then returned for my dog ​​suffering from generalized anxiety: the team took the time to listen to us and understand our needs.

Here, everything is designed to respect the animal: floor consultations, cuddles, and building trust before treatment 🤍 Upon arrival, a separate room is offered to sensitive or reactive dogs.

The prices are consistent with the quality of service and remain very reasonable for Lyon. A caring, professional clinic that truly adapts to each animal: I recommend it without hesitation! 🐶

Following a recommendation, we had our first consultation with Hector at Agapé and we are delighted with our experience!

We received a very warm welcome upon arrival. The entire team is gentle, attentive, and caring, both with the animals and with us. The consultation went very well, with a high level of professionalism, clear explanations, and careful attention to detail.

You can feel a genuine desire to take the time and put the animal at ease, which is particularly appreciated.

A wonderful clinic and a fantastic team that we wholeheartedly recommend! Thank you again for Hector!

My usual vet wasn't available, so I called them and got an appointment that afternoon. I'm so glad I did! I saw a vet who took the time to examine my cat and explain everything clearly. They even called me the next day to check on him. I've decided to change vets!
A beautiful office, excellent service, and several English-speaking staff members.  This is a great clinic.

I will never be able to thank you enough for taking care of Lancelot. You are a wonderful and incredibly reassuring guardian angel.

When others wanted to put him down, you said NO and did everything you could, especially finding out what was wrong with him. 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏
Thank you, thank you, thank you, Dr. Sarah. You will now support me as you so kindly support my sister. You are the best vet in the world, from the universe to infinity and beyond.
THANK YOU, Dr. Sarah LEMERGER! ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️
